node.title: L1 marked common-pencil CRT numerator-fiber bound
node.statement: Fix one bounded-polarity common-pencil chart, all supports and marks, and one exact defect locator F. CRT makes the numerator solutions one affine class modulo the product S of selected support locators. In strip m, every Forney-window cell with t>=m+1 has deg S>d and therefore at most one numerator. At the lower endpoint t=m, threshold arithmetic gives eta=d-m ell<=p-1 and affine freedom degree eta+v<=2p-1, hence at most q^(2p) numerators. For fixed p and generated q=poly(n), numerator multiplicity is polynomial uniformly in the strip; squarefree defect-locator counting is the only non-polynomial common-pencil issue left.
